text:
marta: quick heads up — the KB page /kb/onprem/deploy-steps.md has a broken outbound link to the helm chart (404) when following the install steps in staging. screenshot attached.

simon: which exact link? can you paste the URL so i can grep the repo?

marta: sure — charts.redwood.ai/helm/redwood-0.2.tgz

docs-bot: link-checker scanned thread and found 1 broken outbound link: charts.redwood.ai/helm/redwood-0.2.tgz (reported 1747012345)

kevin: i’m the current owner for on-prem KB pages — i can take this. i’m ~1h on a call but can cut a quick PR afterwards. do we know the new chart path?

olivia: we bumped the chart to 0.3 and uploaded it yesterday. new path should be charts.redwood.ai/helm/redwood-0.3.tgz

simon: if it’s just a version bump, we can sed replace the link in the docs repo and update the note. open a PR and ping me for review.

kevin: opened a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/432 — replaces 0.2 -> 0.3 and adds a short note in the install step about matching chart versions. snippet:

```
- wget https://charts.redwood.ai/helm/redwood-0.2.tgz
+ wget https://charts.redwood.ai/helm/redwood-0.3.tgz
```

marta: thanks! i tested the install in staging with 0.3 and the helm chart installs fine. added that as a QA note in the PR. :thumbsup:

simon: LGTM, will merge after CI is green. small nit: can we add a redirect or shortlink so older doc refs don't 404? not required for this PR though.

kevin: merged PR #432 into main.

deploy-bot: PR #432 merged by kevin. CI: passed. docs site redeploy queued.

release-bot: docs site redeployed to staging — smoke verification passed.

marta: closing the loop here. thanks everyone. tagging @platform-owners for awareness. :white_check_mark:
